method.review: Original briefs and READMEs were reviewed for supplied implementation, named authors, public references, branding, assets and redistribution claims. All source files were read by the evidence scanner; provided-source overlaps and origin markers were examined. Deep source comparison and exact primary shader matching were performed for the six candidates.
method.source_match: Complete64-token lexical windows, case-folded with whitespace ignored, connect original supplied blocks to baseline implementation. Complete normalized fragment programs separately match pinned primary MIT source for three candidates.

candidate_corpus.content_anchored_sampling: normalized48-token windows selected by hash low4bits, identicalwindowcontents verified before recording; filenames not used as identity
candidate_corpus.case_normalization: lowercase lexical tokens, whitespace ignored; punctuation preserved
candidate_corpus.corpus_selection: All original premium implementations, capture directories and all removed projects listed in compliance/project-audit.json; excludes node_modules, build outputs, locks and metadata. Retained originals are not treated as a disputed-source corpus.
candidate_corpus.limits: No exhaustive Internet/source search, visual/legal clearance or ownership inference from matching sharedframework/library code. New original-visual.svg files excluded from implementation-comparison targets. Identical corpus files deduplicated by exactSHA256 and aliases recorded.

method.license_version_rule: Package tarball license text controls the pinned-version finding. Paper0.0.76 archives contain PolyForm Shield1.0.0; verified0.0.82 archives contain Apache-2.0 plus NOTICE. Current website labels were not substituted for old package grants.
method.restriction_rule: Current React Bits Commons Clause and Aceternity source redistribution restrictions do not clear a component pack. They are not used to attribute every unknown component to those vendors.
method.limits: Source searches were bounded. Unverified substantive supplied components remain held rather than receiving a vague MIT assumption. No source/media was copied into the public worktree and no repository edits or public writes occurred during this review.
